item.title: 阿里巴巴 AI 云收入大增 45%，但被 75% 资本开支激增和利润率压缩所掩盖
item.summary: Alibaba Group's June quarter is the clearest statement yet that the company now runs as an AI infrastructure business with an e-commerce cash engine attached, rather than the other way around.
